policy.strategy: sequential greedily cap-repair teams after mandatory 5 rookie-pick contracts/team; avoid losing projected lineup quality, cheaper unowned FA signings on 3Y schedule
policy.rookies: Year1/Year2/Year3 100/125/150%; signed at projected pick salary every draft year
policy.veterans: 100% / (100+s)% / (100+2s)% of signing-year price; existing old players synthetic 2027 newly signed 3Y
policy.release: all cuts at annual preseason settlement; only guaranteed fraction due, recorded per year until original expiration; not transferable without a documented real buyer
policy.noClaims: 14-day claim window assumed expired, no willing buyer observed, no waiver of retained salary
policy.cap: CP6k top120/6 price market (includes rookie contract values, not truly separate MarketValue)
policy.threeYearAnnualCap: 2027 unchanged; 2028 and 2029 base market multiplied by (1+shock), not cumulative; same exogenous NFL player performance for paired worlds
policy.signing: all 30 rookie draft selections per year are treated as automatically signed; 100% first-year guarantee; no 14d cancel-for-free option
policy.freeAgent: signs 3Y at current performance market price; cannot reacquire cut player as fresh 3Y under old dead-cap; no actual free agent bids, authorization or buyer offers
policy.offseasonOnly: no weekly partial salary, no midseason cuts; current year 100% for players signed in current year
policy.allTeam: all 6 managers, up to 40 players, minimum 20 research occupancy, CP6k fixed slot/position counts
policy.exclusions: no accurate historical legacy contract vintages, real NFL 2027+, IR/Taxi, approved picks, claims, trades, competing FA bids, cap-independent rookie market value or hindsight optimization
policy.noHiddenSanction: failure when no candidate bundle legalizes team; does not invent auto-cut, loan or commissioner action
